thread:
nora: Heads-up: product is introducing a new export field `retention_period_days`. Need docs PR + two SDK snippets (ruby + go) + short migration note for old `ttl_days`.
jake: I'll take the SDK snippets. Can someone confirm API surface? Is it `POST /v1/exports`? What's the exact param name and allowed range?
harry: Correct, endpoint is POST /v1/exports. Field is `retention_period_days` (integer). Range: 7-3650. Server will map older `ttl_days` for 90 days with a deprecation warning.
olivia: Legal: use 'retention period' in external docs. Include link to the DPA and a statement that Redwood does not use exported audit data for product analytics. Also avoid the word 'delete' when describing automatic expiry; prefer 'expire' or 'remove from export storage'.
nora: Good. For the docs PR I'll add: - API example (curl) - Ruby and Go SDK snippets - Migration note for existing exports - Support runbook link + contact tag
jake: Ruby snippet (draft):

```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.exports.create(name: 'monthly', retention_period_days: 180, scope: 'tenant')
```

Go snippet (draft):

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
body := redwood.ExportCreate{ Name: "monthly", RetentionPeriodDays: 180, Scope: "tenant" }
client.Exports.Create(context.Background(), body)
```

Will include those in the PR.
harry: Also add server response header example for deprecated param: `X-Deprecation: ttl_days; max-age=7776000` (90 days). Note that accepted-but-deprecated works for both SDKs.
docs-bot: PR opened by nora: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/529 4dd reviewers: olivia, jake, harry. Preview: https://deploy-preview-529--docs.redwood.com
olivia: Quick wording suggestion: replace 'customers can update' with 'customers may configure' in the user-facing paragraph. Add SOC2 note: 'Retention controls are available to customer administrators; audit exports are governed by customer configuration and the DPA.'
support: Adding a support template to the PR: subject, recommended recipients, and opt-in migration flow. We'll need the list of existing exports created before 2026-04-01 for outreach.
nora: I'll add a migration bullet: 'Exports created before 2026-04-01 will not be changed automatically. Admins can update `retention_period_days` to opt in.'
jake: One question: Should we show the old param mapping example? e.g., server accepts `ttl_days` but returns a deprecation header.
harry: Yes, include a short example under 'Migration' showing curl with `ttl_days` and the response header.
jake: Example response snippet added.
olivia: LGTM from legal on the final wording. :white_check_mark: Please avoid 'permanent' and 'forever' in examples.
docs-bot: PR 529 merged to staging by nora 389
nora: Thanks all. I'll trigger the staging build and ping when the docs preview is live. Support please prepare customer copy for next-week batch email.
support: On it. Will coordinate list and send draft by EOD.
